directions.name: heroic_ice
directions.description: Squared beveled glyphs, broad white/ice faces, restrained cyan cut and cobalt outline; FORGE compact and subordinate.
directions.curator_read: Clear and legible after palette reduction, but its native probe is very close to the current placeholder and adds little new identity.

directions.name: faceted_crystal
directions.description: Large crystal facet cuts across the letter faces with cyan highlights and broad navy separation.
directions.curator_read: Strongest crystal identity. The current 4bpp probe keeps SGDK/FORGE readable and counters open; human small-screen review remains pending.

directions.name: forward_energy
directions.description: Forward-leaning geometry, short diagonal cuts, navy shadow and sparse cyan accents.
directions.curator_read: Most motion-oriented; italic posture may make the mark feel sporty and compete with the cinematic reveal.

native_translation_probes.formats: All six plates are indexed 4bpp PNGs, palette index 0 transparent, dimensions 224x48 for SGDK and 192x32 for FORGE, with 13-15 visible colors on the Mega Drive 9-bit grid.
